body.html: What keeps Pathum Thani Place Hotel on the radar is its central location on Tiwanon Road in Bang Kadi, close to the provincial hall, government offices and the Bang Kadi industrial park. Most guests are here for official business, meetings or training in the area, or are drivers who want an overnight stop just north of Bangkok. Reviewers repeatedly mention choosing it because it's easy to find, right on a main road, and simple to get in and out of.

The thing guests praise most consistently is how spacious the rooms are — many describe them as bigger than expected for the price, with comfortable beds and plenty of room to spread out, which suits anyone working with documents or staying several nights. There's an on-site restaurant and a small bar, and several reviews call the food good and handy for late returns when you don't want to head out. Staff come in for regular praise too: warm, easygoing and genuinely helpful with directions or requests.

Free parking is a real plus for self-drivers — there's a generous lot on the property, so you're not hunting for a space in town. The hotel also has meeting rooms used for training and seminars, which is why several local organisations book it for events and put guests up here. Overall it's a plain, function-first hotel: nothing flashy, but it covers the basics that someone on business actually needs.

"Very spacious room, comfortable bed, easygoing staff, and there's a restaurant right in the hotel. Free parking with plenty of space too. For coming into town on business, staying here is just right — good value."

In fairness, Pathum Thani Place Hotel is an older property that's starting to show its age. Several honest reviews mention the building and rooms looking dated, some fittings not being new, and cleanliness that isn't always consistent — a few guests have run into a musty smell, hair in the bathroom, or stains on the bedding that could be handled better. If you get a room that isn't up to scratch, ask the front desk to move you; they'll usually sort it out.

Two more things to set expectations on: Wi-Fi and the location itself. Some reviews note slow internet or patchy signal in certain rooms, so if you'll be working online seriously, bring a mobile-data backup for peace of mind. The setting is a government-and-industrial district rather than a tourist or nightlife zone, so evenings are quiet and there's little to wander out to — though for someone here to work and wanting a quiet night's sleep, that's actually a point in its favour.

Overall, Pathum Thani Place Hotel scores in the fair-to-good range from real reviews — roughly 7–8 out of 10 depending on the platform. It isn't a brand-new hotel and doesn't pretend to be, but measured on central location, spacious rooms, free parking, an on-site restaurant and a price that starts around ฿800 and climbs into the low thousands by season and room type, it does the job of a city hotel for business travellers on a workable budget — just don't expect new or fancy.

faq.q: Where is Pathum Thani Place Hotel?
faq.a: Pathum Thani Place Hotel is at 123 Moo 1, Tiwanon Road, Bang Kadi, Mueang Pathum Thani District — a central-city hotel near the provincial hall, government offices and the Bang Kadi industrial park. It sits right on a main road, easy to find and access, about a 25-minute drive from Don Muang Airport.

faq.q: How much does Pathum Thani Place Hotel cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start around ฿800/night for a Standard room, which is known for being spacious. There's a choice of king and twin layouts plus a roomier Superior. Rates rise by season and room type, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Pathum Thani Place Hotel have parking and a restaurant?
faq.a: Yes to both. There's free parking on the property with a large lot, handy for self-drivers, plus an in-house restaurant and bar so you don't have to go out after dark. It also has meeting rooms for training and seminars.

faq.q: What are the rooms at Pathum Thani Place Hotel like?
faq.a: The rooms are known for being more spacious than expected for the price, with comfortable beds and plenty of room to spread out. Bear in mind the building has been open since 2001, so some rooms look dated and cleanliness isn't always consistent — ask to see the room if walking in, and request a change if it isn't right.

faq.q: Who is Pathum Thani Place Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a strong fit for people handling government errands in central Pathum Thani, attending work or training in the Bang Kadi industrial area, and drivers stopping overnight north of Bangkok who want a central city hotel with spacious rooms and free parking on a workable budget. It isn't new or fancy, but it covers the practical basics.
